_note: 寫作（writing）島 sidecar：一頁多單元。strand=writing。本批 3 個單元覆蓋 5 個知識點：W1 照著抄寫與仿寫（copy-imitate，t_base）；W2 造完整句＋大小寫與標點（sentence-making／punctuation-caps，t_mid）；W3 看圖寫句＋寫簡單信/email（picture-basic／letter-email，t_mid）。英語島治理：語感＞文法、英文學英文（R14＝teach 的 body 全英文零 CJK，中文對照放 zh_hint、預設收合），國小高年級／TOEIC 600-750 可讀的簡單英文，不教台式對比。寫作無法自動批改，故每單元用兩種 practice 混合：(1) 客觀子技能 MCQ（type:mcq、validation_method:expert）測寫作的可客觀判定子技能（句子抄得對不對、是不是完整句、大小寫標點對不對、email 署名放哪裡、哪一句正確描述了圖），有唯一正解、綁 answer_evidence 指向本單元 claims、每個錯項附 distractor_rationales，這類題承載 rubric⑦ 真教真考；(2) 自評產出題（type:writing、validation_method:self）要學生自己寫（抄寫／仿寫／造句／看圖寫一句／寫問候），題目在 answer 欄給明確 model answer／範例，絕不假裝自動批改手寫作文，selfeval_note 要學生對照範例自己判斷（寫對意思即可、用字不必一字不差）→SRS。看圖題的圖內容一律用英文文字描述放在 stem。每個宣告的知識點都在某 teach 段與某 MCQ 的 kp_ids 出現（rubric⑦ 綁定成立，不依賴自評題）。英文示範句／標點／格式／model answer 皆以 Cambridge English 等權威查證、status:provisional、risk_class:normal、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。學習者端零年段字樣。

units.title_zh: 照著抄寫與仿寫句子（copy & imitate）
units.can_do: 我能把一個英文句子一字不差地照抄下來（連大小寫和標點都對），也能照著一個範例句的句型，只換掉一個字，寫出我自己的新句子。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When you copy a sentence, you write it exactly as it is: every letter, every space, the capital letter at the start and in names, and the punctuation mark at the end. You do not add or drop anything.
claims.verification_ref: 抄寫一個句子＝一模一樣寫下來：每個字母、每個空格、句首與名字的大寫、句尾的標點都照抄，不增不減；屬英語基礎寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To imitate a sentence, you keep the same pattern (the same frame of words) and change only one part, such as the noun. The new sentence has the same shape as the model sentence.
claims.verification_ref: 仿寫一個句子＝保留相同句型（相同的字框架），只換掉其中一個部分（例如名詞）；新句子和範例句結構相同；屬英語基礎寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When you copy a sentence, write it exactly the same. Copy every letter and every space. Keep the capital letter at the start, and keep capital letters in names like 'Tom'. Keep the end mark, such as a period (.). Do not add or drop anything.
teach.zh_hint: 抄寫一個句子時，要一模一樣地寫下來。每個字母、每個空格都照抄。句首的大寫、像 Tom 這種名字的大寫都要保留，句尾的標點（例如句點 .）也要保留。不要多加或漏掉任何東西。

teach.body: To imitate a sentence, keep the same pattern and change only one word. If the model is 'I like apples.', you can change the last word and write 'I like bananas.' The shape of the sentence stays the same.
teach.zh_hint: 仿寫一個句子時，保留相同的句型，只換掉一個字。如果範例是 'I like apples.'，你可以換掉最後一個字，寫成 'I like bananas.'，句子的結構維持不變。

teach.body: Model: 'The cat is black.' Copy it: 'The cat is black.' (exactly the same). Imitate it: 'The cat is white.' (same pattern, only one word changed).
teach.zh_hint: 範例：'The cat is black.'。照抄：'The cat is black.'（一模一樣）。仿寫：'The cat is white.'（句型相同，只換了一個字）。

teach.body: Your turn to copy: write this sentence exactly, keeping the capital letter and the period — 'My brother has a new bike.' A correct copy looks exactly the same: My brother has a new bike.
teach.zh_hint: 換你照抄：把這句一字不差寫下來（句首大寫、句尾句點都要）——'My brother has a new bike.'。對照範例自己檢查（不自動批改）：句首 My 大寫、每個字拼對、句尾有句點，就算對。寫完用下面的三級自評。

teach.body: Your turn to imitate: keep the pattern 'I like ___.' and change only the last word to a food you like. Example answers: I like bananas. / I like rice.
teach.zh_hint: 換你仿寫：保留句型 'I like ___.'，只換最後一個字，寫出你喜歡的一種食物。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：句型是 'I like ___.'、換的是一種食物、拼寫正確即可（用字不必和範例一樣）。範例：I like bananas.／I like rice.。

practice.stem: 範例句是 'I have a red ball.'。下面哪一句是把它『完全正確地照抄』下來？
options: I have a red ball.
i have a red ball.
I have a red ball
I have a red boll.

句首的 I 沒有大寫；照抄時句首大寫要保留。
distractor_rationales.I have a red ball: 句尾漏了句點（.）；照抄時句尾標點要保留。
把 ball 抄錯成 boll，改動了字；照抄不能改動任何字。

practice.feedback: 照抄＝一字不差：句首 I 大寫、每個字拼對、句尾句點都保留，所以 'I have a red ball.' 才完全正確。

practice.stem: 範例句是 'She likes dogs.'。哪一句是正確的『仿寫』——句型一樣，只換掉其中的名詞？
options: She likes cats.
She likes dogs very much.
She like cats.
Dogs likes she.

多加了 very much，句型變長了；仿寫只換一個字，不加字。
動詞漏了 -s（主詞 She 要用 likes）；仿寫要保留原句型，包括 likes。
把字的順序打亂了，句型完全不同，不是仿寫。

practice.feedback: 仿寫＝保留 'She likes ___.' 的句型，只把名詞 dogs 換成 cats，寫成 'She likes cats.'。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你抄好／仿寫好的句子出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊檢查有沒有漏字、句首大小寫和句尾標點對不對。

lines.text: My brother has a new bike.

units.title_zh: 造出完整句＋大小寫與標點（complete sentences & punctuation）
units.can_do: 我能寫出有主詞和動詞、意思完整的句子，也能正確地用大小寫（句首、人名地名）、句尾標點（. ? !）和條列用的逗號。
units.situation_group: 寫作：完整句與標點大小寫
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A complete sentence has a subject (who or what the sentence is about) and a verb (what the subject does or is), and it makes complete sense on its own. For example, 'Birds fly.' has a subject (Birds) and a verb (fly), so it is a complete sentence.
claims.verification_ref: 完整句＝有主詞（這句在講的人或東西）和動詞（主詞做什麼或是什麼），而且本身意思完整；例 'Birds fly.' 有主詞 Birds、動詞 fly，是完整句；屬英語基礎語法通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In English you begin every sentence with a capital letter, and you also capitalize proper nouns — the names of people, days, months, and places, such as 'Anna', 'Monday', and 'Taipei'.
claims.verification_ref: 英文每句句首要大寫，專有名詞（人名、星期、月份、地名，如 Anna／Monday／Taipei）也要大寫；屬英語標準大小寫規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Every sentence ends with a punctuation mark: a period (.) for a statement, a question mark (?) for a question, and an exclamation mark (!) for a strong feeling.
claims.verification_ref: 每句句尾要有標點：直述句用句點（.）、問句用問號（?）、強烈情緒用驚嘆號（!）；屬英語標準標點規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: You use a comma (,) to separate three or more items in a list, for example: 'I like milk, juice, and water.'
claims.verification_ref: 條列三樣或以上的東西時，各項之間用逗號（,）隔開，例 'I like milk, juice, and water.'；屬英語標準標點規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A complete sentence needs two things: a subject and a verb. The subject is who or what the sentence is about. The verb tells what the subject does or is. The sentence must also make complete sense on its own. For example, 'Birds fly.' has a subject (Birds) and a verb (fly), so it is complete. A group of words like 'the happy dog' has no verb, so it is not a sentence yet.
teach.zh_hint: 一個完整的句子需要兩樣東西：主詞和動詞。主詞是這句話在講的人或東西，動詞說明主詞做什麼或是什麼。句子本身還要意思完整。例如 'Birds fly.' 有主詞（Birds）和動詞（fly），所以是完整句；像 'the happy dog' 這樣只有一串字、沒有動詞，還不算句子。

teach.body: Begin every sentence with a capital letter. Also use a capital letter for proper nouns: names of people, days, months, and places, like 'Anna', 'Monday', and 'Taipei'. End a statement with a period (.), a question with a question mark (?), and a strong feeling with an exclamation mark (!). When you list three or more things, put a comma between them: 'I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.'
teach.zh_hint: 每句句首要用大寫。專有名詞也要大寫：人名、星期、月份、地名，例如 Anna、Monday、Taipei。直述句句尾用句點（.），問句用問號（?），強烈情緒用驚嘆號（!）。條列三樣或以上的東西時，各項之間要加逗號：'I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.'

teach.body: Not a sentence: 'the happy dog' — it has no verb and no capital or end mark. Complete and correct: 'The happy dog runs.' — it starts with a capital 'The', has a subject (The happy dog) and a verb (runs), and ends with a period.
teach.zh_hint: 不是句子：'the happy dog'——沒有動詞，也沒有大寫和句尾標點。完整又正確：'The happy dog runs.'——句首 The 大寫、有主詞（The happy dog）和動詞（runs）、句尾有句點。

teach.body: Your turn: write one complete sentence about a family member. It must have a subject and a verb, start with a capital letter, and end with a period. Example answers: My mother cooks dinner. / My father reads books.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：寫一個關於家人的完整句子。要有主詞、有動詞，句首大寫、句尾加句點。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：有主詞有動詞、意思完整、大寫與句點都對即可（用字可不同）。範例：My mother cooks dinner.／My father reads books.。

teach.body: Your turn: rewrite this line with correct capital letters and punctuation — 'my friend tom lives in taipei'. Correct version: My friend Tom lives in Taipei.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把這一行改成大小寫和標點都正確的句子——'my friend tom lives in taipei'。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：句首 My 大寫、人名 Tom 與地名 Taipei 大寫、句尾加句點。正解：My friend Tom lives in Taipei.。

practice.stem: 下面哪一個是『完整的句子』（有主詞也有動詞，意思完整）？
practice.answer: The children play in the park.
options: The children play in the park.
A big yellow school bus.
Running very fast.
In the morning.

這只有一個名詞詞組，沒有動詞，所以不是完整句。
沒有主詞（是誰在跑？），所以不是完整句。
這是一個片語，沒有主詞也沒有動詞，不是完整句。

practice.feedback: 'The children play in the park.' 有主詞（The children）和動詞（play），意思完整，所以是完整句。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句的大小寫和句尾標點『全部正確』？
practice.answer: My friend Anna lives in Taipei.
options: My friend Anna lives in Taipei.
my friend anna lives in taipei.
My friend Anna lives in Taipei
my Friend Anna lives in Taipei.

句首 my 沒大寫，人名 anna 和地名 taipei 也沒大寫。
句首 my 沒大寫，卻把普通字 Friend 大寫了，大小寫用錯地方。

practice.feedback: 'My friend Anna lives in Taipei.'：句首 My 大寫、人名 Anna 與地名 Taipei 大寫、句尾有句點，全部正確。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句在條列三樣東西時，逗號用得正確？
practice.answer: I like milk, juice, and water.
options: I like milk, juice, and water.
I like milk juice and water.
I like, milk, juice and water.
I, like milk, juice and water.

三樣東西之間完全沒有逗號隔開。
逗號放錯位置（like 後面不該放逗號），而且 juice 和 water 之間也漏了逗號。
在主詞 I 後面放了不該有的逗號，條列的逗號也不齊。

practice.feedback: 條列三樣東西時，各項之間用逗號隔開：'I like milk, juice, and water.' 的逗號位置正確。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你寫好的句子出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊確認『有沒有主詞和動詞』『句首大寫、句尾標點對不對』。

lines.text: My friend Tom lives in Taipei.

units.title_zh: 看圖寫句＋寫簡單的信/email（picture & email）
units.can_do: 我能看一張圖，用簡單的句子寫出圖裡有誰、在做什麼、在哪裡；也能寫一封給朋友的短 email，包含問候語、本文、以及結尾署名加自己的名字。
units.situation_group: 寫作：看圖寫句與書信格式
units.subject: eng

claims.text: To describe a picture, write simple sentences about what you see: who is in the picture, what they are doing, and where they are. You can begin with 'There is' or 'There are' to say what the picture shows.
claims.verification_ref: 看圖寫句＝用簡單句子寫出看到的內容：圖裡有誰、在做什麼、在哪裡；可用 'There is／There are' 開頭說明圖中有什麼；屬英語基礎寫作通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A short email to a friend has three basic parts: a greeting at the top (for a friend, 'Hi Anna,' or 'Dear Anna,'), the body in the middle where you write your message, and a closing at the end with a sign-off and your name (for example, 'Your friend, Ben').
claims.verification_ref: 一封給朋友的短 email 有三個基本部分：最上面的問候語（朋友間用 'Hi Anna,' 或 'Dear Anna,'）、中間寫訊息的本文、最後的結尾（署名語＋自己的名字，例 'Your friend, Ben'）；屬英語基礎書信格式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The closing comes last, after the body. A friendly sign-off such as 'Your friend,' or 'Best wishes,' is written on its own line, and your own name goes on the line below it.
claims.verification_ref: 結尾放在最後、本文之後；友善的署名語（如 'Your friend,' 或 'Best wishes,'）單獨寫一行，自己的名字寫在它的下一行；屬英語基礎書信格式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When you describe a picture, look carefully and write simple sentences about what you see. Say who is in the picture, what they are doing, and where they are. You can start with 'There is a ...' or 'There are ...'. For example: 'There is a boy. He is riding a bike in the park.'
teach.zh_hint: 看圖寫作時，仔細看圖，用簡單的句子寫出你看到的東西。說出圖裡有誰、他們在做什麼、在哪裡。可以用 'There is a ...' 或 'There are ...' 開頭。例如：'There is a boy. He is riding a bike in the park.'

teach.body: A short email to a friend has three parts. First comes the greeting, such as 'Hi Anna,'. Next comes the body, where you write your message. Last comes the closing: a friendly sign-off like 'Your friend,' on one line, and your own name on the next line.
teach.zh_hint: 一封給朋友的短 email 有三個部分。最先是問候語，例如 'Hi Anna,'。接著是本文，寫你要說的訊息。最後是結尾：友善的署名語（例如 'Your friend,'）寫一行，自己的名字寫在下一行。

teach.body: Picture (in words): a girl is sitting at a table and eating an apple. You can write: 'A girl is sitting at a table. She is eating an apple.' Short email: 'Hi Anna,' / 'I am having fun at camp. See you soon!' / 'Your friend,' / 'Ben'.
teach.zh_hint: 圖（用文字描述）：一個女孩坐在桌子旁吃蘋果。你可以寫：'A girl is sitting at a table. She is eating an apple.'。短 email：'Hi Anna,'／'I am having fun at camp. See you soon!'／'Your friend,'／'Ben'。

teach.body: Your turn: look at this picture (in words) — 'A girl is reading a book under a tree.' Write one sentence to describe it. Example answers: A girl is reading a book under a tree. / There is a girl. She is reading under a tree.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：看這張圖（文字描述）——'A girl is reading a book under a tree.'，寫一句英文描述它。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：寫出『誰、在做什麼、在哪裡』、是完整句、拼寫大致正確即可（用字可不同）。範例：A girl is reading a book under a tree.／There is a girl. She is reading under a tree.。

teach.body: Your turn: write a short email to a friend with three parts — a greeting, one line of body, and a closing with your name (four lines). Example: Hi Anna, / I am having fun at camp. See you soon! / Your friend, / Ben.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：寫一封給朋友的短 email，含三部分——問候語、一句本文、結尾署名＋自己的名字（可分四行）。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：朋友名字和內容可不同，只要三部分齊全、格式正確即可。範例：Hi Anna,／I am having fun at camp. See you soon!／Your friend,／Ben。

practice.stem: 看這張圖（圖的內容以英文描述）：'A boy is riding a bicycle in the park. The sun is shining.' 下面哪一句正確地描述了這張圖？
practice.answer: A boy is riding his bike in the park.
options: A boy is riding his bike in the park.
A girl is riding a bike in the park.
A boy is walking in the park.
A boy is riding a bike at school.

圖裡是一個男孩（a boy），不是女孩。
圖裡的男孩在『騎腳踏車』，不是走路。
圖裡的地點是公園（in the park），不是學校。

practice.feedback: 圖的描述說 a boy is riding a bicycle in the park，所以正確描述是 'A boy is riding his bike in the park.'——人物、動作、地點都相符。

practice.stem: 一封寫給朋友 Anna 的 email，下面哪一句最適合當『開頭的問候語』？
options: Hi Anna,
Your friend, Ben
I am fine, thank you.
The end.

distractor_rationales.Your friend, Ben: 這是放在最後的結尾署名，不是開頭的問候語。
這是本文裡的一句話，不是問候語。
這不是 email 會用的句子，也不是問候語。

practice.feedback: 寫給朋友的 email，開頭的問候語用 'Hi Anna,'（或 'Dear Anna,'）放在最上面。

practice.stem: 一封 email 的『結尾署名』應該放在哪裡、怎麼寫？
practice.answer: 放在本文之後的最後面：先寫 'Your friend,'，下一行再寫自己的名字。
options: 放在本文之後的最後面：先寫 'Your friend,'，下一行再寫自己的名字。
放在最前面，問候語的前面。
放在本文的中間。
署名要寫收件人的名字，不是自己的名字。

distractor_rationales.放在最前面，問候語的前面。: 結尾署名是放在最後、本文之後，不是放在最前面。
distractor_rationales.放在本文的中間。: 結尾署名要放在整封信的最後，不是夾在本文中間。
distractor_rationales.署名要寫收件人的名字，不是自己的名字。: 署名寫的是『寄信人自己』的名字，不是收件人的名字。

practice.feedback: 結尾放最後、本文之後：署名語 'Your friend,' 寫一行，自己的名字寫在下一行。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你寫好的描述句和短 email 出聲讀一遍，檢查句子是否完整、email 的問候語與署名是否齊全。
